chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch 408: Court Politics, Li Sui’s Growth, and the Walking Corpse Emperor Arrives
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang sits through a political conspiracy he doesn't care about, worries about Li Sui's rapid maturation, and gets a shocking surprise when the walking corpse emperor makes an entrance.
og_description: Bored by rebellion politics, Li Huowang frets over Li Sui's growth—then the dead king walks in.
twitter_title: Ch 408: The dead emperor arrives in the flesh?!
twitter_description: Li Huowang ignores a coup planning session, worries his daughter-parasite is growing too fast, and gets blindsided by a very undead monarch.

lore_anchors.definition: A folkloric term for a body that moves and acts as if alive despite being dead; in xianxia, it often implies a puppet controlled by a malevolent force.
A term describing someone who refuses to commit to any side in a conflict, supporting whichever party seems strongest at the moment.
The fallen dynasty that Zhuge Yuan and his allies are trying to restore; its emperor is rumored to be a walking corpse.
The government's supernatural affairs bureau; Old Qin was once a member despite his high political standing.
A secret society that weaponizes lies and falsehood; Li Huowang desperately wants one to appear so he can force it to reveal a cure for his hallucinations.
The orthodox path of seeking truth in xianxia; Zhuge Yuan promises to help Li Huowang find one after the political restoration.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why doesn't Li Huowang care about the political conspiracy?
cultural_notes_faq.a: He's hyperfocused on his own survival: Li Sui is maturing fast, and he needs a Zuowandao to force out the cure for his hallucinations before it's too late. Court drama feels irrelevant.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is so shocking about the emperor arriving?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Earlier, Li Huowang was told the Great Qi emperor was a "walking corpse"—a dead body animated by dark forces. If he's now making a public appearance, either the earlier intel was wrong or something far worse is happening.

She's growing more sentient and independent: she asks questions about things she doesn't understand, expresses concern for her dad's hunger, and has moved from hiding in his stomach to spreading across his entire body.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What does Zhuge Yuan mean by a 'true cultivation method'?
cultural_notes_faq.a: In the Dao-Twisted World, orthodox xianxia "truth-seeking" cultivation (修真) stands in contrast to the Zuowandao's philosophy of "cultivating falsehood into reality." A true method could help Li Huowang escape his hallucinations.
